## A cell with no figure

## A cell with a table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cars
#| tbl-cap: "A table from a cell with a wrap class."
#| classes: wrap-right

```

![A figure after the table cell, with no wrap class.](plot.png){#fig-after-table width="50%"}

The figure above keeps its normal layout. See @fig-after-table and @tbl-cars.

The figure above keeps its normal layout and its 30% width. See @fig-unwrapped-cell.
